manual_recovery_link: I want to manually recover my wallets
moved_description: Your wallets are safe. Move them to the new app, they also stay on this site.
moved_home_screen_hint: This icon keeps opening the old address. Once your wallets have moved, open %{host} in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, and remove this icon.
handoff_consent_description: An encrypted copy is sent to the new app. Your wallets also stay on this site.
handoff_unlock_description: Enter the password for these wallets to confirm the move. It is checked on this device and never sent.
handoff_sent_title: Your wallets are on their way
handoff_sent_description: Continue in the %{host} tab. You can close this window.
handoff_nothing_here_description: There are no wallets to move in this browser. You can close this window.
handoff_lost_opener_description: Nothing was sent. Open %{host} and start the move from there.
handoff_failed_description: Nothing was sent, and nothing changed on this site. Start again from the new app.
recovery_description: Each wallet will show its recovery phrase once you unlock it. Write the words down, then restore them in the new app.
recovery_nothing_left_description: Every wallet whose recovery phrase was stored in this browser has been signed out.
recovery_unlock_description: Unlock to see the recovery phrase of this wallet.
recovery_phrase_description: Write down or copy these words, then restore the wallet in the new app. Anyone with these words can take your funds.
recovery_copy_blocked: Copying is blocked — write them down
recovery_sign_out_description: The wallet will be removed from this browser. It can only be restored with its recovery phrase.
recovery_sign_out_confirm: I have a backup copy of the recovery phrase for %{wallet}
home_screen_title: Add the app to your Home Screen again
home_screen_description: This icon still opens the old address. Open %{host} in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. You can then remove this icon.
